The bird is captured with wings raised in an upstroke or glide, displaying dark brown/grey plumage on the body and wings, with a white head and neck. The distinctive long bill with a gular pouch is clearly visible, pointing downwards. The legs are tucked back, trailing behind the tail.

The tail is visible between the legs and under the wing base, appearing short and consistent with the wedge shape.
